lines.japanese: ま、終わらないんですけどね。
lines.english: Well, it wasn't over yet.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、悪いが先に行かせてもらうぞ」
lines.english: “Sorry, but we'll have to go on ahead.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん山科、ゆっくり休んでて」
lines.english: “Sorry, Yamashina. Take your time and rest.”

lines.japanese: 俺と渡来明日香は、ふたり先行して社務所へと向かった。お遊び気分で申しでたとはいえ、一応は正規のアルバイトだ、遅刻するわけにもいかない。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai and I went on ahead to the shrine office. We might have volunteered in a playful mood, but this was still a legitimate part-time job. We could not be late.

lines.japanese: 気分のすぐれない山科京をハリュー・クロードに任せるのはいささか不安だったが、すぐに良くなるという彼女の言葉を信じよう。
lines.english: I was a little uneasy about leaving the unwell Kyou Yamashina with Claude Haryuu, but I would trust her assurance that she would recover quickly.

lines.japanese: ちなみに土地土地の伝統芸能にハマり中だというハリュー・クロードは、このあと持参のなまはげコスプレで獅子舞とのバトルショーを披露する算段らしい。
lines.english: Claude Haryuu, who was currently obsessed with the traditional performing arts of different regions, apparently planned to put on a lion-dance battle show later in a namahage costume he had brought with him.

lines.japanese: ときとして、天才は凡人の理解を超えたところへ行きつくものだ。
lines.english: At times, genius arrives at destinations beyond the comprehension of ordinary men.

lines.japanese: 俺と渡来明日香は獅子舞バイトの受付を済ませ、略式ながら一通りの説明も受講した。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai and I checked in for our lion-dance job and received a complete, if abbreviated, explanation.

lines.japanese: あとはいよいよ実地で華麗に舞うだけという段。
lines.english: Now all that remained was to enter the field and dance magnificently.

lines.japanese: 俺は賑わう参道の端で、ひとり獅子頭を抱えて相方を待っていた。
lines.english: I stood alone at the edge of the bustling shrine approach, cradling the lion head as I waited for my partner.

lines.japanese: 「まったく、女という生き物はどうしていちいち着替えが遅いんだ……」
lines.english: “Honestly, why do women have to take so long changing every single time...?”

lines.japanese: はっぴ姿のいなせな美男子がこんなところで粋に突っ立っていたら、晴れ着ギャルの逆ナンが殺到して場に混乱を来たしかねないじゃないか。
lines.english: If a dashing young man in a festival coat stood here looking this stylish, girls in New Year’s finery might swarm over to hit on him and throw the whole place into chaos.

lines.japanese: 夜は更けても、祭りはまだまだ宵の口。今夜は家族連れも子供グループも、就寝時刻を忘れてはしゃいでいる。
lines.english: The night was growing late, but the festival had only just begun. Tonight, families and groups of children alike forgot their bedtimes and reveled.

lines.japanese: そういやうちの妹は、ふむ、今ごろ吉川さん家でぬくぬくしてるのだろう。
lines.english: That reminded me of my own little sister. Hmm. By now, she was probably warm and cozy at Yoshikawa's house.

lines.japanese: 大好きなお兄ちゃんが今夜は家にいないと知って、寂しがり屋の小鳩も友人宅で年越しすることにしたみたいだ（注：理由は俺の推測です）。
lines.english: Knowing that her beloved big brother would not be home tonight, lonely little Kobato had apparently decided to spend New Year's Eve at a friend's house. (Note: This motive is my own conjecture.)

lines.japanese: 良い子のふたりだから大丈夫だとは思うが、まさかこんな時間に外をほっつき歩いたりはしてないだろうな。
lines.english: They were both good girls, so I was sure they would be fine. But they wouldn't be roaming outside at this hour, would they?

lines.japanese: あんな可愛い少女たち（とくに小鳩の可愛さは神々の奇跡にも等しい）が歩いてたら、変質者どもの格好の的だ。
lines.english: If girls that adorable were walking around—especially Kobato, whose beauty rivaled a miracle of the gods—they would make perfect targets for every deviant out there.

lines.japanese: もちろん俺はロリコンとかそういうの全然ないんだけど、いまの世の中にはそういった嗜好を持つ変態も多いからな。
lines.english: Naturally, I didn't have a sister complex or any interest in little girls. But there were plenty of perverts with such tastes in the world today.

lines.japanese: ああどうしよう。とても可愛い小鳩（＋小鳩ほどじゃないけど結構可愛い吉川さん）の安全が心配だ。いてもたってもいられない。
lines.english: Oh, what should I do? I feared for the safety of the extremely adorable Kobato, plus Yoshikawa, who was quite adorable too, though not as adorable as Kobato. I could not sit still.

lines.japanese: ええい、こんなことしてる場合か。
lines.english: Damn it, this was no time for lion dancing.

lines.japanese: マシなのは外面だけのプリンセスなんかより、外も中も美しい小鳩（＋小鳩ほどじゃないけどそれなりに美しい吉川さん）の身を救いに行かねば……
lines.english: I had to rescue Kobato, beautiful inside and out, plus Yoshikawa, reasonably beautiful but not as beautiful as Kobato. They mattered far more than some princess whose looks were the only decent thing about her...

lines.japanese: 「まあ、俺そんな、シスコンとかロリコンとかは全然ないけどね」
lines.english: “Not that I have a sister complex or any interest in little girls.”

lines.japanese: 「なにが？」
lines.english: “What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 焦燥感から思わず漏れた独り言に、通行人のレスが返ってきた。
lines.english: A passerby responded to the thought that had escaped my lips in my agitation.

lines.japanese: 振りかえれば、柔らかな電灯に浮かびあがった美少女の姿が──
lines.english: I turned. In the soft electric light stood a beautiful girl—

lines.japanese: 「げっ！　渡来明日香！」
lines.english: “Gah! Asuka Watarai!”

lines.japanese: ──く、くそ不覚っ、夜の中の薄明かりのせいで一瞬とはいえ美少女などと思ってしまった。
lines.english: —D-damn it. The dim light at night had made me think she was a beautiful girl, if only for an instant.

lines.japanese: えっ、なに言ってるんだよ、渡来さんはいつだって綺麗だよ。
lines.english: What are you talking about? Watarai is always beautiful.

lines.japanese: うるさい黙れタカシ、くだらないこと口走るんじゃねえぞテメエ。
lines.english: Shut up, Takashi. Don't you dare say that stupid shit aloud.

lines.japanese: 鷲介、おまえも余計なおべんちゃらとか必要ねえからな、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。
lines.english: And Shuusuke, no pointless flattery from you either. I'll fucking kill you, asshole.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに。なんで私いま睨まれてんの」
lines.english: “Um, why are you glaring at me?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　っせえな仕方ねえだろ、気ぃ張ってなきゃ今日の渡来さんは一段とお美しいとか、アホなことぬかしかねねーんだよ」
lines.english: “Huh? Shut up. I can't help it. If I don't stay on guard, I might say something idiotic like, ‘You look even more beautiful than usual today, Watarai.’”

lines.japanese: 渡来明日香のまぶたが半分落ちた。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai's eyelids lowered halfway.

lines.japanese: 「はあ～あ……ぱね田くんに誉められてもあんまり嬉しくないよね」
lines.english: “Siiigh... It doesn't make me very happy when Paneda compliments me.”

lines.japanese: 「ほ、ほほほ誉めてなんかいませんっ！」
lines.english: “I-I-I wasn't complimenting you!”

lines.japanese: 「へいへい。じゃあ、さっさとソレ被って」
lines.english: “Sure, sure. Now hurry up and put that thing on.”

lines.japanese: 「わぶっ！？」
lines.english: “Wbuf?!”

lines.japanese: やつが俺の手から獅子頭を奪って、俺の頭にがっぽり被せた。視界が極端に狭くなる。俺はよろめきながら訊いた。
lines.english: She snatched the lion head from my hands and dropped it over my head. My field of vision narrowed drastically. I staggered as I asked her a question.

lines.japanese: 「う、うおうっ、俺が前でいいのか」
lines.english: “Wh-whoa! You're okay with me in front?”

lines.japanese: 「まー、とりあえずね。そっちのが面白そうだから、あとで交替してもらうけど」
lines.english: “For now. Being in front looks more fun, so I’m making you switch with me later.”

lines.japanese: 「るふう、貴様がごとき凡人には後ろ脚の方が似合いだと思うがな。文字通り余の手となり足となりて、グレタガルドが為──ひゃうん！」
lines.english: “Hrrfoo. A commoner such as you is better suited to the hind legs. Become my hands and feet in the service of Gretagard—hyaun!”

lines.japanese: とつぜん背後から脇腹を掴まれて、得も言われぬ感覚が駆けのぼった。
lines.english: Something seized my sides from behind, and an indescribable sensation raced up my body.

lines.japanese: 「えー？　なんか言ったー？」
lines.english: “What? Did you say something?”

lines.japanese: 被り物のせいで俺の声はよく通らないようだ。渡来明日香がしゅるりと両腕を巻きつけてくる。
lines.english: Apparently, my voice did not carry well through the costume. Asuka Watarai slipped both arms around me.

lines.japanese: 気付けば俺たちは唐草模様のマントに覆われていて、そのせいで閉塞感というか密着感というかそんなよーなアレが、妙に艶めかしく男女の空気をこもらせていた。
lines.english: Before I knew it, we were covered by the arabesque-patterned cape. The enclosure—or the close bodily contact, or something of that nature—trapped a strangely sensual atmosphere between man and woman.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ！　たたタンマタンマ！　なんかやばい、なんかコレいかがわしい！　ぶるっきゃう、俺ぶるっきゃう！」
lines.english: “W-wait! Time out! Something's wrong! This feels obscene! Burukyau! I'm gonna burukyau!”

lines.japanese: 「え？　え？　うそ、もう始まったの！？」
lines.english: “What? Wait, did we start already?!”

lines.japanese: 動揺した俺は前へ前へと逃げたが、前脚の意図が伝わっていない後ろ脚には演舞の一環だと勘違いされたらしく、しがみつく力がより強くなっていった。
lines.english: In my agitation, I tried to escape by moving forward. But the hind legs could not understand the front legs' intentions and mistook it for part of the dance, so they clung to me even more tightly.

lines.japanese: 「あッ！　ななな、なんかいま背中に悩ましげな感触！？　ら、らめえ、俺には心に決めたひとが、あっ、うそ、でもちょっと嬉しい！」
lines.english: “Ah! Wh-wh-what was that bewitching sensation against my back?! N-no, I have already pledged my heart to another. Ah! Wait, this is kind of nice!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょちょぱね田くん、いきなり動き過ぎだよ！　激しい、激しいってば。行かないで、まだ行かないで！」
lines.english: “W-w-wait, Paneda! You're moving too much all of a sudden! Too hard! You're going too hard! Don't go yet! Not yet!”

lines.japanese: 「初めてだから優しくしてね！？」
lines.english: “It's my first time, so be gentle!”

lines.japanese: 思わず鷲介的に叫んでいた。
lines.english: The Shuusuke part of me cried out without thinking.

lines.japanese: 「ふぬん、傀儡の王女が国王たる余に意見する気か貴様！　おのれ００１め、その程度の微弱な束縛など、奈落の名に懸けて振りほどいてくれるわ。そうれ、ゲイ・ボル・ク！　ゲイ・ボル・ク！」
lines.english: “Hrnn! Does the puppet princess presume to lecture her king?! Curse you, 001! In the name of the abyss, I shall throw off so feeble a restraint! Gáe Bolg! Gáe Bolg!”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だからトバしすぎだって！　と、ととと、こける、こけるっ」
lines.english: “I told you you're going too fast! W-we're gonna fall! We're falling!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃははっ！　ママー、あのししまいさん、おもしろーい」
lines.english: “Ah-ha-ha! Mommy, that lion dance is funny!”

lines.japanese: だが俺たちの舞は、予想外に好評だったようだ。
lines.english: Yet our dance appeared to be an unexpected hit.

lines.japanese: 「な、なんか分からんが結果オーライだな。ようし、このまま図にのって本殿までカチ込みを……ややっ、あれは！」
lines.english: “I have no idea what we're doing, but all's well that ends well. Fine! Let us ride this momentum and storm the main sanctuary... Hm? What is that?!”

lines.japanese: 勢いづいた矢先、詣で客の中にふと知った顔を見つけた。
lines.english: Just as my spirits rose, I spotted a familiar face among the worshipers.

lines.japanese: 「きゃーっは！　見ろよ林田あのシシマイ、ちょおウケんだけど！」
lines.english: “Ah-ha-ha! Look, Hayashida! That lion dance is freaking hilarious!”

lines.japanese: むう、あの無駄に声がでかいあの女は、我がクラスの問題児（まあ我がクラス問題児だらけだが）高内昌子副委員長じゃないか。
lines.english: Hmm. That pointlessly loud woman was Masako Takauchi, vice representative and resident problem child of our class. (Admittedly, our class was full of problem children.)

lines.japanese: 「はあ、はあっ……ま、待ってください高内先輩……」
lines.english: “Haah, haah... W-wait for me, Takauchi...”

lines.japanese: 連れだっているのは部活の後輩だろうか、高内昌子とは正反対の幸薄そうな女だ。
lines.english: The girl with her was probably a younger member of her club. She looked as unfortunate as Masako Takauchi looked fortunate.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、先輩がおひとりでずんずか先へ進まれるんで、みんなついてこられな……あ、あれっ？　他の先輩方はどこへ……？」
lines.english: “Takauchi, you kept marching ahead by yourself, so nobody could keep up... W-wait. Where did everybody else go...?”

lines.japanese: 「あん？　はぐれたん？　ま、いーよ、荷物持ちはひとりいりゃ十分だし」
lines.english: “Huh? We lost 'em? Whatever. I only need one person to carry my stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「私、荷物持ちだったんですか！」
lines.english: “Wait, I’m just your pack mule?!”

lines.japanese: む、あの下級生は高内昌子にパシられているのか。気の毒に。なんだか昔のタカシを見ているようで放っとけない気分になる。
lines.english: Hmm. Was that younger girl being used as Masako Takauchi's errand runner? Poor thing. She made me think of the old Takashi, and I could not leave her to her fate.

lines.japanese: 「おい、聞こえるか後ろ脚、こちらで討伐対象を補足した。これより任務を遂行するぞ」
lines.english: “Do you read me, hind legs? We have acquired a target. Commencing the operation.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　だから、そんな小さい声じゃ聞こえな……あ、あれ高内？」
lines.english: “What? I can't hear you when you talk that quiet... Oh. Is that Takauchi?”

lines.japanese: 当然だが敵には俺たちの顔が見えていないので、ただの年越し名物としか思われていない。
lines.english: Naturally, the enemy could not see our faces and regarded us as nothing more than a New Year's attraction.

lines.japanese: 「なー林田、たしかシシマイに齧られると縁起イイとかゆーよな」
lines.english: “Hey, Hayashida, they say it's good luck if the lion bites you, right?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい。ネットで見たんですけど、神聖な獣に邪気を食べてもらうことで幸福が訪れるって言われてるらしいです」
lines.english: “Yes. I read online that happiness comes when you let the sacred beast devour the evil spirits clinging to you.”

lines.japanese: 「へー、詳しいじゃん。なにおまえ、マニアなの」
lines.english: “Huh. You know your stuff. What, are you some kinda fanatic?”

lines.japanese: 「そういうわけじゃないですけど、ええ、まあ、普通です」
lines.english: “Not really. Well, I’m pretty normal, I guess.”

lines.japanese: なんかこの子、うちのタカシと相性よさそうだな……渡来明日香みたいなアバズレより、こっちの子の方が素直で優しそうだし。
lines.english: This girl might get along well with our Takashi... She seemed more honest and kind than a tramp like Asuka Watarai.

lines.japanese: ええっ、なに言ってるんだよ、渡来さんだってとっても素直で優しい女の子だよ。
lines.english: What are you saying? Watarai is a very honest, kind girl too.

lines.japanese: どーすかねえ、腹の内じゃなに考えてるか分かんないっすよ？
lines.english: I dunno about that. Who knows what she's thinking deep down?

lines.japanese: あーもー、おまいらケンカすんなてー。
lines.english: Aw, come on, you guys. Quit fightin'.

lines.japanese: 「おし林田、そんじゃせっかくだし、うちらもカプッと一発やってもらおーじゃん」
lines.english: “Okay, Hayashida. Since we're here, let's have it give us a nice chomp too.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、でも先輩、子供じゃなきゃお獅子に齧られても意味がないって説もあってですね」
lines.english: “Oh, but Takauchi, there is one theory that being bitten by the lion only has meaning for children.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、いんだよ、こーゆーのはノリでしょ。ねえ！　ちょー、そこの獅子舞的なひとー」
lines.english: “Shut up. It's fine. This stuff is all about going with the flow. Hey! Yo, lion-dance person!”

lines.japanese: 高内昌子が腰を曲げて、盛りすぎ頭を俺に差しだしてきた。
lines.english: Masako Takauchi bent at the waist and offered me her absurdly overdone hairdo.

lines.japanese: ククク、自ら敵陣に飛びこんでくるとは愚かな女よ。俺は獅子頭の上顎と下顎をがちんがちん重ねあわせて笑った。
lines.english: Heh-heh-heh. Foolish woman, leaping willingly into the enemy's camp. I laughed by clacking the lion head's upper and lower jaws together.

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ、行くぞ！　必殺、グレタガリバーニング・超獅子奮迅噛み！」
lines.english: “Here I come! Finishing move: Gretagari Burning: Super Lion Rampage Bite!”

lines.japanese: 「痛あーっ！　いたたた！　なに、何コイツ、おもクソ噛んでんだけど！　なんで！　ちょ、いてーッて！　痛ッ、痛ったーッ！」
lines.english: “Owww! Ow, ow, ow! What the hell? This thing's biting crazy hard! Why?! Hey, that hurts! Ow! Owww!”

lines.japanese: 「どうだ悪のメドゥーサめ、這いつくばらんか！　這いつくばらんか！　タカシ的な女の子の平和は私が守る！」
lines.english: “How do you like that, wicked Medusa?! Grovel before me! Grovel! I shall protect the peace of every Takashi-type girl!”

lines.japanese: 「痛だだだだ！　てめアタマ挟んだまま喋ってんじゃねーよ、がっつんがっつん当たンだろ！　いた、痛゛ーッ！　てんめ、こンの……」
lines.english: “Owowowow! Don't talk with my head still in your mouth, asshole! The jaws keep hammering into me! Ow! Owww! You fucking—”

lines.japanese: 「ざけんなッ！」
lines.english: “Cut the shit!”

lines.japanese: 「ひぎぃ！」
lines.english: “Hngh!”

lines.japanese: メドゥーサの爪先が俺の弁慶的なところを直撃した。
lines.english: Medusa’s toe struck me squarely in that all-too-vulnerable spot on my shin.

lines.japanese: 「ぐっ……くく、機動力３０％ダウン……被害が甚大だ、わたなんとかさん、前後交替してくれ」
lines.english: “Guh... Hrk. Mobility reduced by thirty percent... Damage critical. Wata-whatever, switch positions with me.”

lines.japanese: 「いいけど……大丈夫？」
lines.english: “Sure... You okay?”

lines.japanese: 「名誉の負傷だ、痛くはないさ」
lines.english: “A wound of honor. It doesn't hurt.”

lines.japanese: これであのタカシ的な女の子（略して鷹子）に笑顔が戻るのなら。
lines.english: If it restored a smile to that Takashi-type girl—Takako for short—it was worth the pain.

lines.japanese: ああそうだ、どうやら鷹子は美空学園の生徒みたいだからな。もし今後また困っている場面に遭遇したら、俺が陰ながら助けになってあげよう。
lines.english: Oh, right. Takako appeared to be a student at Misora Academy. If I found her in trouble again, I would secretly come to her aid.

lines.japanese: 俺は姿を隠したまま獅子頭を脱いで、すばやく後ろ脚のポジションに回った。
lines.english: Keeping myself hidden, I removed the lion head and swiftly moved into the hind-leg position.

lines.japanese: 「はーい、それじゃ次のお嬢さん、頭を出してくださーい」
lines.english: “All right, next young lady! Please present your head!”

lines.japanese: 前方では、交替した渡来明日香が獅子の顎をがちんがちん鳴らしていた。
lines.english: Up front, Asuka Watarai had taken over and was clacking the lion's jaws together.

lines.japanese: 「は、はいお願いしますっ！　私これで頭よくなって、先輩に見直されたいんです」
lines.english: “Y-yes, please! I want this to make me smarter so an older student I know will think better of me.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、この子どっかで見たことあるような……むしろ日常的に……」
lines.english: “Wait, haven't I seen this girl somewhere...? Like, every day...?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　なんです？」
lines.english: “What? Did you say something?”

lines.japanese: 「ああいや、なんでも」
lines.english: “Oh, no. Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　なんだおい、ほとんど聞こえないけど、客に話しかけてるのか？　なに余計なことしてるんだ、おまえ」
lines.english: “Hm? Hey, I can barely hear you, but are you talking to the customer? Quit doing pointless stuff.”

lines.japanese: 俺は自分を棚に上げて非難した。
lines.english: I criticized her with heroic disregard for my own behavior.

lines.japanese: 「うるさい、黙って後ろ脚やってろ」
lines.english: “Shut up and stay back there being the hind legs.”

lines.japanese: へいへい……。
lines.english: Sure, sure...

lines.japanese: しかしこいつ、驚くほど腰細いな……つうか、なんか、いい匂いするんだけど……。
lines.english: Wow, though. Her waist was shockingly narrow... And she smelled kind of nice...

lines.japanese: い、いや、べつに気にならないけどね！　こんなのより、うちの小鳩のキャンディ臭の方がよっぽどいい香りだし。あっ、でもべつに俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないけどね！
lines.english: N-not that I cared! Kobato smelled much better, like candy. Ah, but I didn't have a sister complex or any interest in little girls!

lines.japanese: というわけで、この中なんか渡来臭いから、ちょっと唐草マントめくって換気しよう。
lines.english: Anyway, it smelled too much like Watarai in here, so I lifted the arabesque cape a little to let in some air.

lines.japanese: おっ。声は聞こえないけど、外の様子がちょっとは見えるな。
lines.english: Oh. I couldn't hear any voices, but now I could see outside a little.

lines.japanese: 「ああ失敬。ふむふむ、それで、お嬢さんはその先輩とやらに恋をしておるのかな？」
lines.english: “Oh, pardon me. Hmm, hmm. So, young lady, are you in love with this older student of yours?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あ、あの、はい……そう、なんです……片思いですけど……」
lines.english: “What? Um, y-yes... I am... It's unrequited, though...”

lines.japanese: 「ふむ、ときにお嬢さん。君の想い人は同じ学校なのかね？」
lines.english: “I see. Tell me, young lady. Does the object of your affection attend the same school?”

lines.japanese: 「はい……でもそのひとはもうすぐ卒業されるんです。どうしよう、羽田先輩に会えなくなっちゃうよ……」
lines.english: “Yes... But he's graduating soon. What am I going to do? I won't get to see Haneda anymore...”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり私、玉砕覚悟で告白するべきなんでしょうか」
lines.english: “Should I confess, even if I know I'm marching to my doom?”

lines.japanese: 「や、１００パー玉砕するからやめるべき」
lines.english: “No. You'll be rejected one hundred percent, so don't.”

lines.japanese: 「傷付いた！」
lines.english: “That hurt!”

lines.japanese: 「告白すればもっと傷付く結果に」
lines.english: “Confessing would hurt you even more.”

lines.japanese: 「神様のばかあああああ！」
lines.english: “You stupid god!”

lines.japanese: ん？　なんだなんだ？　鷹子のやつ、まだ齧られてないのにどっか走ってっちゃったぞ。
lines.english: Hm? What happened? Takako ran off somewhere before she even got bitten.

lines.japanese: 「おいワンタン麺さん、いまの子いったい──」
lines.english: “Hey, Wonton Noodle, who was that girl—”

lines.japanese: 「山科だいじょぶかねえ」
lines.english: “I wonder if Yamashina's okay.”

lines.japanese: 「──あ？　ああ、そうだな」
lines.english: “—huh? Oh. Yeah.”

lines.japanese: なんだか不自然に話題を逸らされた気もするが、まあ、山科さんの容体が気になるのは確か──
lines.english: It felt as though she had changed the subject rather unnaturally, but I really was concerned about Yamashina's condition—

lines.japanese: 「なあ和馬ァ」
lines.english: “Hey, Kazuma.”
—hm?

lines.japanese: な、なんだ？　いま一瞬、後ろの方から、やたらとカッコいい固有名詞が聞こえてきたような……？
lines.english: Wh-what was that? For a moment, I thought I heard an incredibly cool proper noun somewhere behind me...

lines.japanese: 「あー？　なんだよ大輔」
lines.english: “Yeah? What is it, Daisuke?”

lines.japanese: はっ！　こ、こここ、この“天使の鐘”とも形容すべき心洗われる声は！
lines.english: Ah! Th-this voice, pure enough to cleanse the soul, could only be described as an angel's bell!

lines.japanese: 「あったく、おまえが『ドキドキ☆晴れ着の上からＤカップ当てクイズ！』やろうなんて言いださなかったら、亜衣たちとはぐれることもなかったのによーう……」
lines.english: “Man, if you hadn't suggested playing ‘Heart-Pounding Kimono D-Cup Guessing Game,’ we never would've lost Ai and the others...”

lines.japanese: もっ！
lines.english: Mo!

lines.japanese: も、も、ももっ、も、ももももももも……！
lines.english: M-m-momo, mo, momomomomomo...!

lines.japanese: 「　も　り　さ　と　く　ん　だ　！　」
lines.english: “IT'S MORISATO!”

lines.japanese: 次の瞬間──
lines.english: The next instant—

lines.japanese: 「え、なに！？　あっ、待てこら、獅子舞ドロボー！」
lines.english: “What?! Hey, wait, you lion-dance thief!”

lines.japanese: ──俺は渡来明日香の頭からオリエンタル・ライオンヘッドを引っこぬいて、ひとり駆けだしていた。
lines.english: —I yanked the Oriental Lion Head from Asuka Watarai's head and took off alone.

lines.japanese: 「なんだァ？　なんかあの辺うっさくね？」
lines.english: “What the hell? Something's real noisy over there.”

lines.japanese: 「おぉ、つか、なんかこっち向かってきて──」
lines.english: “Whoa. Something's coming this way—”

lines.japanese: 「ももも、もり、もりっ……もりもりモリィィィ　ももももりいいい！」
lines.english: “Mo-mo-mori, mori... Morimori MORIIII! M-m-moriiiiii!”

lines.japanese: 「う、うわあああっ！？　な、なんだこのキショい獅子舞！」
lines.english: “Waaaaah?! Wh-what is with this creepy lion dance?!”

lines.japanese: 俺はたてがみとマントを振りみだしながら、森里君めがけ飛びついた。ついでに脱がそうとした。
lines.english: I sprang at Morisato with mane and cape flying. While I was there, I tried to strip him.

lines.japanese: 「こええ、こええよ！　なんでいきなり俺に飛びついてくんだよコイツ！」
lines.english: “Scary! This is scary! Why'd this thing jump on me out of nowhere?!”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！？　そんな、ひどいや森里君、初詣に行くなら親友の俺も誘ってくれればいいのに！」
lines.english: “What?! That's so cruel, Morisato! If you were going for the first shrine visit, you should've invited your best friend!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そうか、俺に噛まれたかったんだね。俺に獅子舞をやってほしいから、本当は誘いたかったくせに涙を呑んで誘わなかったんだ。そう、それだ」
lines.english: “Oh, I see. You wanted me to bite you. You really wanted to invite me because you wanted me to perform the lion dance, but you swallowed your tears and stayed silent. Yes. That's it.”

lines.japanese: 「ようし、そんじゃあ今すぐいっぱい齧ってあげるぞ。あっ、でも俺には、君を力いっぱい噛むなんてひどいことできないから甘噛みにしよう。うふふ、耳とかをね。そうれ、かしゅ～」
lines.english: “All right, then I'll give you lots of bites right now. Oh, but I could never do anything as cruel as biting you with all my strength, so I'll nibble gently. Hee-hee, on your ear. Here goes. Kashuuu.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあっ！　超きめえええええ、痛くないけどなんかきめえええええ！」
lines.english: “Waaah! That's so freaking creepy! It doesn't hurt, but it's so freaking creepy!”

lines.japanese: 「ひいいいっ！　お、お、お、犯されるぅー！」
lines.english: “Eeeek! I-I'm going to be violated!”

lines.japanese: 森里君たちはすっかり狂乱して、ちっとも俺の話を聞かないまま逃げさってしまった。
lines.english: Morisato and his friends fell into utter pandemonium and fled without listening to a word I said.

lines.japanese: けれども俺は、君に逢えた喜びですっかり足の痛みを忘れることが出来たんだ。
lines.english: But the joy of seeing you made me forget all about the pain in my leg.

lines.japanese: やっぱりいつだって俺を助けてくれるんだね。ありがとう森里君。
lines.english: You always save me, no matter what. Thank you, Morisato.

lines.japanese: 遠ざかる友の背に感謝の言葉を贈る俺でしたとさ。
lines.english: And so I sent my thanks to my friend's retreating back.

lines.japanese: めでたしめでたし。
lines.english: And they all lived happily ever after.
